# AuroraASR-1M

AuroraAI Research · released 2026-10

Pinned public FP32 checkpoint and maker-documented Transformers runtime; custom code required. Weight count is 949,073 per architecture section; runtime memory is estimated, not measured.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/AuroraAI-Research/AuroraASR-1M)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/AuroraAI-Research/AuroraASR-1M/blob/cd307b54b4d666d6ad7dc982a7a58a96d6e7f942/README.md)

Published measurements are available, but there is not enough shared evaluation data to calculate a comparable overall score yet.

## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp32, needs ~0.5 GB, from [huggingface.co/AuroraAI-Research](https://huggingface.co/AuroraAI-Research/AuroraASR-1M/blob/cd307b54b4d666d6ad7dc982a7a58a96d6e7f942/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   python -m pip install torch transformers sentencepiece soundfile && python -c "import soundfile as sf; from transformers import AutoModelForCTC; model = AutoModelForCTC.from_pretrained('AuroraAI-Research/AuroraASR-1M', trust_remote_code=True).eval(); wav, sr = sf.read('audio.wav', dtype='float32'); print(model.transcribe(wav)[0])"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/AuroraAI-Research](https://huggingface.co/AuroraAI-Research/AuroraASR-1M)
